title: v18: the flow designer and simulator stop teaching and emulating the single-brace `{var}` dialect, which objectstack#19939 deletes (the objectui half of #19939 pass 4, S7)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939

Filing gate: cross-repo rule 3. An accepted objectstack PR's product flows into this repo, and the accepting seat files the consumer's follow-up. The stage plan `6096263424` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 names this as "a companion card in objectui, filed by this seat at each stage's ACCEPT". This one is S7's, the close-out. objectui#12101 is S1's.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader who acts: objectui triage, to route it. The sites are in `packages/app-shell`.

**Unlock:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 closes when PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23252 merges. Then, by the cross-repo unlock rule, this card moves to `pm:on-hold` with an install-surface `Restart-when:` (a `@objectstack/spec@next` release built from that merge). It is dispatched only once objectui resolves that release.

## What changes upstream (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23252)

- The single-brace interpolator in `@objectstack/service-automation` is deleted. Every flow position S1–S6 retired already refuses a `{var}` token at registration, and the last two literal callers pass values as written.
- Every flow condition is CEL. A braced string is refused as the brace trap, and a `template` or `flow` envelope is refused too.
- `@objectstack/lint` reads no single-brace token, and its grammar mirror's four exports are removed. objectui's pin `1fb1ced36` imports none of them.

## The sites here, measured by the S7 dev at objectui `ee470719`

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`:
  - `:690` and `:706`: collection placeholders `'{leadList}'` / `'{items}'` with `refMode: 'template'`;
  - `:350` and `:361`: help text calling a collection an `interpolate()` template;
  - `:589` and `:816`: descriptions saying "interpolates `{var}`".
- `inspectors/json-schema-to-fields.ts:102`, `:259` and `:295`: `xExpression: 'template'` mapped to a single-brace picker.
- `previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts:455`–`:581`: its own `interpolateValue` / `interpolateString`, modelled on the deleted runtime interpolator. The simulator would show a run the engine refuses.

## Acceptance

Run on the installed release:

- No designer site offers, prescribes or describes a `{var}` token. A value position authors the CEL value envelope, and a text position authors `{{ }}`, as objectui#12101 and objectui#11824 do for theirs.
- The simulator evaluates what the engine evaluates. Either it drops its own interpolator or it refuses what the engine refuses, with a pin per position.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included:
- `objectstack#19939 single-brace dialect retired designer companion value slot CEL envelope picker` → 8 hits. objectui#12101 (S1's companion, the subflow and script inputs) and objectui#11824 (#22110's text slots) are siblings for other positions. None is these sites.
- `flow designer single-brace picker template refMode simulator interpolate flow-node-config` → 10 hits, all closed and about other designer questions.

Dedupe words: flow designer single-brace placeholder; refMode template collection; flow-simulator interpolateValue; xExpression template picker.
